mechanism: Methylprednisolone may increase ethinyl estradiol metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing oral contraceptive efficacy; conversely, estrogens may increase corticosteroid levels by displacing protein binding and reducing metabolism.
action: Monitor for breakthrough bleeding and reduced contraceptive efficacy; consider alternative or additional contraception methods during methylprednisolone therapy and for 2-4 weeks after discontinuation.
